application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
T1 : Tag No 35964 - Corsican Pine Tree (dead)
Dangerous tree fell as close to ground level as possible.

T2 : Tag No 35579 - Poplar tree
Requires an urgent re-pollard, back to the prior reduction points. This will maintain the health of the tree and prevent fall out close by to the childrens play area.

T3 : Tag No 35578 - Lime tree
Requires urgent deadwooding and a lift by approximately 5 metres, plus a reduce and reshape by approximately 2-3 metres to balance the tree.  This will maintain the health of the tree and prevent fall out close by to the childrens play area.

T4 : Tag No 35963 - Acacia tree
Dangerous leaning tree, fell as close to ground level as possible.

T5 : Tag No 35605 - Sycamore tree
Dangerous tree shedding branches, reduce the dying tops down to the next substantial growth point, which is approximately 3 metres and reshape the sides to match and provide balance to the tree.  This will maintain the health of the tree and prevent fall out in a well used common area.
